Translations.English:
Don't worry, your lives
will regenerate soon!
Translations.French: Ne t’inquiète pas, tes vies\nse régénéreront bientôt !
Translations.Japanese: 心配しないで、ライフは\nすぐに回復するよ！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 别担心，你的生命值\n很快会恢复！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 別擔心，你的生命值\n很快會恢復！
Translations.German: Keine Sorge, deine Leben\nregenerieren sich bald!
Translations.Spanish: No te preocupes, tus vidas\nse regenerarán pronto.
Translations.Italian: Non preoccuparti, le tue vite\nsi rigenereranno presto!
Translations.Portuguese: Não se preocupe, suas vidas\nvão se regenerar em breve!

Translations.Japanese: 星5評価をお願いします
フィードバックありがとうございます！

Translations.French: (Facultatif) Dites aux autres ce que vous en pensez
Translations.Japanese: （任意）感想を教えてください
Translations.Italian: (Facoltativo) Dì agli altri cosa ne pensi
Translations.Portuguese: (Opcional) Conte aos outros o que você acha

Translations.Japanese: 次のライフまでの時間:

Translations.English:
You will have a chance to get
special rewards!
Translations.French: Tu auras une chance d’obtenir\ndes récompenses spéciales !
Translations.Japanese: 特別な報酬を\n獲得するチャンス！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 你将有机会获得\n特殊奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 你將有機會獲得\n特殊獎勵！
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu akan punya kesempatan untuk mendapatkan\nhadiah spesial!
Translations.German: Du hast die Chance,\nspezielle Belohnungen zu erhalten!
Translations.Italian: Avrai la possibilità di ottenere\nricompense speciali!
Translations.Portuguese: Você terá a chance de ganhar\nrecompensas especiais!
Translations.Russian: У тебя будет шанс получить\nособые награды!

Translations.English:
Activate the <color=#F7B926>Loop Pass</color> to
get additional exclusive rewards!
Translations.French: Active le <color=#F7B926>Pass Loop</color> pour\nobtenir des récompenses exclusives supplémentaires!
Translations.Japanese: <color=#F7B926>ループパス</color>を有効化して\n追加の限定報酬を獲得しよう!
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 激活<color=#F7B926>循环通行证</color>\n即可获得额外的专属奖励!
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 啟用<color=#F7B926>循環通行證</color>\n即可獲得額外的專屬獎勵!
Translations.Indonesian: Aktifkan <color=#F7B926>Loop Pass</color> untuk\nmendapatkan hadiah eksklusif tambahan!
Translations.German: Aktiviere den <color=#F7B926>Loop-Pass</color>, um\nzusätzliche exklusive Belohnungen zu erhalten!
Translations.Spanish: Activa el <color=#F7B926>Pase Loop</color> para\nconseguir recompensas exclusivas adicionales!
Translations.Italian: Attiva il <color=#F7B926>Pass Loop</color> per\nottenere ricompense esclusive aggiuntive!
Translations.Portuguese: Ative o <color=#F7B926>Passe Loop</color> para\nreceber recompensas exclusivas adicionais!
Translations.Russian: Активируйте <color=#F7B926>Пропуск Loop</color>, чтобы\nполучать дополнительные эксклюзивные награды!

Translations.English:
Activate the <color=#FED32F>Loop Pass</color> and
complete all stages to unlock the
Bonus Bank!
Translations.Turkish: <color=#FED32F>Loop Bileti</color>'ni etkinleştir ve\ntüm aşamaları tamamlayarak\nBonus Bankası'nın kilidini aç!
Translations.French: Active le <color=#FED32F>Pass Loop</color> et\ntermine toutes les étapes pour débloquer la\nBanque Bonus!
Translations.Japanese: <color=#FED32F>ループパス</color>を有効化して\nすべてのステージをクリアすると\nボーナスバンクが解放されます!
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 激活<color=#FED32F>循环通行证</color>并\n完成所有阶段以解锁\n奖励银行!
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 啟用<color=#FED32F>循環通行證</color>並\n完成所有階段以解鎖\n獎勵銀行!
Translations.Korean: <color=#FED32F>루프 패스</color>를 활성화하고\n모든 스테이지를 완료해\n보너스 뱅크를 잠금 해제하세요!
Translations.Indonesian: Aktifkan <color=#FED32F>Loop Pass</color> dan\nselesaikan semua tahap untuk membuka\nBank Bonus!
Translations.German: Aktiviere den <color=#FED32F>Loop-Pass</color> und\nschließe alle Stufen ab, um die\nBonus-Bank freizuschalten!
Translations.Spanish: Activa el <color=#FED32F>Pase Loop</color> y\ncompleta todas las etapas para desbloquear el\nBanco de Bonos!
Translations.Italian: Attiva il <color=#FED32F>Pass Loop</color> e\ncompleta tutte le fasi per sbloccare la\nBanca Bonus!
Translations.Portuguese: Ative o <color=#FED32F>Passe Loop</color> e\nconclua todas as etapas para desbloquear o\nBanco de Bônus!
Translations.Russian: Активируйте <color=#FED32F>Пропуск Loop</color> и\nпройдите все этапы, чтобы открыть\nБонус-банк!

Translations.English: Buy now to unlock all stages!
Translations.Turkish: Şimdi satın al, tüm aşamaları aç!
Translations.French: Achetez maintenant pour débloquer toutes les étapes !
Translations.Japanese: 今すぐ購入して全ステージをアンロック！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 立即购买以解锁所有阶段！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 立即購買以解鎖所有階段！
Translations.Korean: 지금 구매하고 모든 스테이지를 잠금 해제하세요!
Translations.Indonesian: Beli sekarang untuk membuka semua tahap!
Translations.German: Jetzt kaufen, um alle Stufen freizuschalten!
Translations.Spanish: ¡Compra ahora para desbloquear todas las etapas!
Translations.Italian: Acquista ora per sbloccare tutte le fasi!
Translations.Portuguese: Compre agora para desbloquear todas as etapas!
Translations.Russian: Купите сейчас, чтобы открыть все этапы!

Translations.French: Terminez des niveaux pour gagner des prix !
Translations.Japanese: レベルをクリアして賞品を獲得！
Translations.German: Schließe Level ab, um Preise zu gewinnen!
Translations.Italian: Completa i livelli per vincere premi!

Translations.English: Tap the truck to sort the cubes
Translations.French: Touchez le camion pour trier les cubes
Translations.Japanese: トラックをタップしてキューブを仕分けよう
Translations.German: Tippe auf den LKW, um die Würfel zu sortieren
Translations.Spanish: Toca el camión para ordenar los cubos
Translations.Italian: Tocca il camion per ordinare i cubi
Translations.Portuguese: Toque no caminhão para ordenar os cubos
Translations.Russian: Нажмите на грузовик, чтобы отсортировать кубики

Translations.English:
Only send cubes to the truck
with the same color
Translations.French: N'envoie au camion que des cubes\nde la même couleur
Translations.Japanese: 同じ色のキューブだけをトラックへ\n送ってください
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 只把方块送到卡车上\n颜色必须相同
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 只把方塊送到卡車上\n顏色必須相同
Translations.Indonesian: Hanya kirim kubus ke truk\ndengan warna yang sama
Translations.German: Schicke nur Würfel zum LKW\nin derselben Farbe
Translations.Spanish: Envía solo cubos al camión\ndel mismo color
Translations.Italian: Invia al camion solo i cubi\ndello stesso colore
Translations.Portuguese: Envie apenas cubos ao caminhão\nda mesma cor
Translations.Russian: Отправляй кубики на грузовик\nтолько одного цвета

Translations.English: Accept each offer to claim free rewards.
Translations.Turkish: Her teklifi kabul et, ücretsiz ödülleri al.
Translations.French: Acceptez chaque offre pour récupérer des récompenses gratuites.
Translations.Japanese: 各オファーを受け取って無料報酬を獲得しよう。
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 接受每个优惠以领取免费奖励。
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 接受每個優惠以領取免費獎勵。
Translations.Korean: 각 제안을 수락하고 무료 보상을 받으세요.
Translations.Indonesian: Terima setiap penawaran untuk klaim hadiah gratis.
Translations.German: Nimm jedes Angebot an, um kostenlose Belohnungen abzuholen.
Translations.Spanish: Acepta cada oferta para reclamar recompensas gratis.
Translations.Italian: Accetta ogni offerta per riscattare ricompense gratuite.
Translations.Portuguese: Aceite cada oferta para resgatar recompensas grátis.
Translations.Russian: Примите каждое предложение, чтобы забрать бесплатные награды.

Translations.English:
Remove ads and get an
additional reward!
Translations.Turkish: Reklamları kaldır ve\nek bir ödül kazan !
Translations.French: Supprime les pubs et obtiens\nune récompense supplémentaire !
Translations.Japanese: 広告を削除して\n追加報酬をゲット！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 移除广告并获得\n额外奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 移除廣告並獲得\n額外獎勵！
Translations.German: Entferne Werbung und erhalte\neine zusätzliche Belohnung!
Translations.Spanish: Elimina los anuncios y consigue\nuna recompensa adicional.
Translations.Italian: Rimuovi gli annunci e ottieni\nuna ricompensa aggiuntiva!
Translations.Portuguese: Remova os anúncios e ganhe\numa recompensa adicional!

Translations.English:
You'll still be able to get rewards for
watching ads!
Translations.French: Tu pourras toujours obtenir des récompenses en\nregardant des pubs !
Translations.Japanese: 広告を見て報酬を\n獲得することもできるよ！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 你仍然可以通过观看广告\n获得奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 你仍然可以透過觀看廣告\n獲得獎勵！
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu tetap bisa mendapatkan hadiah dengan\nmenonton iklan!
Translations.German: Du kannst weiterhin Belohnungen erhalten,\nindem du Werbung ansiehst!
Translations.Italian: Potrai comunque ottenere ricompense\nguardando gli annunci!
Translations.Portuguese: Você ainda poderá ganhar recompensas por\nassistir a anúncios!
Translations.Russian: Ты всё равно сможешь получать награды за\nпросмотр рекламы!

Translations.Japanese: <color=#FDB707>ミッション</color>をクリアして\nキューブを獲得！
<color=#FDB707>キューブ</color>を集めて\n報酬をアンロック！
隠れたブロックを明らかにする
超難しいレベルに勝つ

Translations.English:
Portals move cubes instantly
Link entry and exit points
Translations.Turkish: Portallar küpleri anında taşır\nGiriş ve çıkış noktalarını bağla
Translations.French: Les portails déplacent les cubes instantanément\nRelie les points d’entrée et de sortie
Translations.Japanese: ポータルはキューブを瞬時に移動させる\n入口と出口をリンクしよう
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 传送门可瞬间移动方块\n连接入口和出口
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 傳送門可瞬間移動方塊\n連接入口和出口
Translations.Korean: 포털은 큐브를 즉시 이동시켜요\n입구와 출구를 연결하세요
Translations.Indonesian: Portal memindahkan kubus secara instan\nHubungkan titik masuk dan keluar
Translations.German: Portale bewegen Würfel sofort\nVerbinde Ein- und Ausgänge
Translations.Spanish: Los portales mueven cubos al instante\nVincula los puntos de entrada y salida
Translations.Italian: I portali spostano i cubi all’istante\nCollega i punti di entrata e uscita
Translations.Portuguese: Portais movem cubos instantaneamente\nConecte os pontos de entrada e saída
Translations.Russian: Порталы мгновенно перемещают кубики\nСвяжи точки входа и выхода

Translations.English: Reveal the hidden cube by tapping the cube in front
Translations.Turkish: Öndeki küpe dokunarak gizli küpü ortaya çıkar
Translations.French: Révélez le cube caché en touchant le cube devant
Translations.Japanese: 手前のキューブをタップして隠れキューブを出そう
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 点击前面的方块以揭示隐藏方块
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 點擊前面的方塊以揭示隱藏方塊
Translations.Korean: 앞의 큐브를 탭해 숨겨진 큐브를 드러내세요
Translations.Indonesian: Ketuk kubus di depan untuk membuka kubus tersembunyi
Translations.German: Decke den versteckten Würfel auf, indem du den Würfel davor antippst
Translations.Spanish: Revela el cubo oculto tocando el cubo de delante
Translations.Italian: Rivela il cubo nascosto toccando il cubo davanti
Translations.Portuguese: Revele o cubo oculto tocando no cubo da frente
Translations.Russian: Откройте скрытый кубик, нажав на кубик спереди

Translations.English: Sort the color required on curtain to remove it
Translations.Turkish: Perdeyi kaldırmak için perdede istenen rengi sırala
Translations.French: Triez la couleur demandée sur le rideau pour le retirer
Translations.Japanese: カーテンに必要な色を仕分けて取り除こう
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 整理幕布上要求的颜色以移除它
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 整理幕布上要求的顏色以移除它
Translations.Indonesian: Urutkan warna yang diminta pada tirai untuk menghapusnya
Translations.German: Sortiere die auf dem Vorhang geforderte Farbe, um ihn zu entfernen
Translations.Spanish: Ordena el color requerido en la cortina para quitarla
Translations.Italian: Ordina il colore richiesto sulla tenda per rimuoverla
Translations.Portuguese: Organize a cor exigida na cortina para removê-la
Translations.Russian: Отсортируйте нужный цвет на занавесе, чтобы убрать его

Translations.English:
The barrier prevents the truck from moving
Cubes can enter a truck with a barrier, but cannot exit
Translations.Turkish: Bariyer kamyonetin hareket etmesini engeller\nKüpler bariyerli bir kamyonete girebilir, ancak çıkamaz
Translations.French: La barrière empêche le camion de bouger\nLes cubes peuvent entrer dans un camion avec une barrière, mais ne peuvent pas en sortir
Translations.Japanese: バリアはトラックの移動を妨げる\nキューブはバリア付きトラックに入れるが、出られない
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 障碍物会阻止卡车移动\n方块可以进入有障碍物的卡车，但无法出来
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 障礙物會阻止卡車移動\n方塊可以進入有障礙物的卡車，但無法出來
Translations.Korean: 장벽은 트럭이 움직이지 못하게 해요\n큐브는 장벽이 있는 트럭에 들어갈 수 있지만, 나올 수는 없어요
Translations.Indonesian: Penghalang mencegah truk bergerak\nKubus bisa masuk ke truk dengan penghalang, tapi tidak bisa keluar
Translations.German: Die Barriere verhindert, dass sich der Lkw bewegt\nWürfel können in einen Lkw mit Barriere hinein, aber nicht heraus
Translations.Spanish: La barrera impide que el camión se mueva\nLos cubos pueden entrar en un camión con barrera, pero no pueden salir
Translations.Italian: La barriera impedisce al camion di muoversi\nI cubi possono entrare in un camion con barriera, ma non possono uscire
Translations.Portuguese: A barreira impede o caminhão de se mover\nCubos podem entrar em um caminhão com barreira, mas não podem sair
Translations.Russian: Барьер не даёт грузовику двигаться\nКубики могут войти в грузовик с барьером, но не могут выйти

Translations.English: Break the ice by filling the truck next to it
Translations.French: Brisez la glace en remplissant le camion à côté
Translations.Japanese: 隣のトラックを満タンにして氷を壊そう
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 填满旁边的卡车来打破冰块
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 填滿旁邊的卡車來打破冰塊
Translations.Indonesian: Pecahkan es dengan mengisi truk di sebelahnya
Translations.German: Zerbrich das Eis, indem du den Truck daneben füllst
Translations.Spanish: Rompe el hielo llenando el camión de al lado
Translations.Italian: Rompi il ghiaccio riempiendo il camion accanto
Translations.Portuguese: Quebre o gelo enchendo o caminhão ao lado

Translations.English: Reveal the key to open the lock.
Translations.Turkish: Kilidi açmak için anahtarı ortaya çıkar
Translations.French: Révélez la clé pour ouvrir le cadenas.
Translations.Japanese: 鍵を出してロックを開けよう
Translations.German: Decke den Schlüssel auf, um das Schloss zu öffnen.
Translations.Spanish: Revela la llave para abrir el candado.
Translations.Italian: Rivela la chiave per aprire il lucchetto.
Translations.Portuguese: Revele a chave para abrir a fechadura.

Translations.English: A truck with a tag can only be filled with the same-colored cubes
Translations.Turkish: Etiketli bir kamyon yalnızca aynı renkteki küplerle doldurulabilir
Translations.French: Un camion avec une étiquette ne peut être rempli qu'avec des cubes de la même couleur
Translations.Japanese: タグ付きトラックは同じ色のキューブしか入れられない
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 带标签的卡车只能装入相同颜色的方块
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 帶標籤的卡車只能裝入相同顏色的方塊
Translations.Korean: 태그가 있는 트럭은 같은 색 큐브만 채울 수 있습니다
Translations.Indonesian: Truk dengan tag hanya bisa diisi dengan kubus berwarna sama
Translations.German: Ein Truck mit Tag kann nur mit gleichfarbigen Würfeln gefüllt werden
Translations.Spanish: Un camión con etiqueta solo puede llenarse con cubos del mismo color
Translations.Italian: Un camion con un tag può essere riempito solo con cubi dello stesso colore
Translations.Portuguese: Um caminhão com etiqueta só pode ser preenchido com cubos da mesma cor
Translations.Russian: Грузовик с меткой можно заполнять только кубиками того же цвета

Translations.English:
Tape blocks cubes from exiting the trucks
Sort one truck to break all the tape
Translations.Turkish: Bant küplerin kamyonetlerden çıkmasını engeller\nBir kamyoneti sırala, tüm bantları kır
Translations.French: Le ruban empêche les cubes de sortir des camions\nTrie un camion pour casser tout le ruban
Translations.Japanese: テープでキューブがトラックから出られない\n1台を仕分けするとテープが全部はがれる
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 胶带会阻止方块从卡车中出来\n整理一辆卡车即可移除所有胶带
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 膠帶會阻止方塊從卡車中出來\n整理一輛卡車即可移除所有膠帶
Translations.Korean: 테이프가 큐브가 트럭에서 나오는 것을 막아요\n트럭 하나를 분류하면 테이프가 모두 제거돼요
Translations.Indonesian: Selotip menghalangi kubus keluar dari truk\nSortir satu truk untuk memutus semua selotip
Translations.German: Klebeband verhindert, dass Würfel die Lkws verlassen\nSortiere einen Lkw, um das gesamte Klebeband zu entfernen
Translations.Spanish: La cinta impide que los cubos salgan de los camiones\nOrdena un camión para quitar toda la cinta
Translations.Italian: Il nastro impedisce ai cubi di uscire dai camion\nOrdina un camion per rimuovere tutto il nastro
Translations.Portuguese: A fita impede que os cubos saiam dos caminhões\nOrdene um caminhão para remover toda a fita
Translations.Russian: Лента не даёт кубикам выходить из грузовиков\nОтсортируй один грузовик, чтобы убрать всю ленту

Translations.English: Sort trucks to roll the Carpet
Translations.French: Triez les camions pour dérouler le tapis
Translations.Japanese: トラックを仕分けてカーペットを広げよう
Translations.German: Sortiere Trucks, um den Teppich auszurollen
Translations.Spanish: Ordena camiones para desenrollar la Alfombra
Translations.Italian: Ordina i camion per srotolare il Tappeto
Translations.Portuguese: Organize caminhões para desenrolar o Tapete

Translations.English: Once the spawner is empty, it refills automatically
Translations.Turkish: Üretici boşalınca otomatik olarak yeniden dolar
Translations.French: Une fois le générateur vide, il se remplit automatiquement
Translations.Japanese: スポナーが空になると自動で補充される
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 生成器为空后会自动补充
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 生成器為空後會自動補充
Translations.Indonesian: Setelah spawner kosong, akan terisi otomatis
Translations.German: Sobald der Spawner leer ist, füllt er sich automatisch wieder auf
Translations.Spanish: Una vez que el generador esté vacío, se rellena automáticamente
Translations.Italian: Una volta che lo spawner è vuoto, si ricarica automaticamente
Translations.Portuguese: Quando o gerador fica vazio, ele se recarrega automaticamente
Translations.Russian: Когда спавнер пуст, он автоматически пополняется

Translations.French: Appuyez sur le camion pour mélanger
Translations.Japanese: トラックをタップしてシャッフル
Translations.German: Tippe auf den Lkw, um zu mischen

Translations.Japanese: 最後のブロックを元に戻す
毎日ボーナスを受け取ろう！
Translations.German: Hole dir deinen Bonus jeden Tag!
Translations.Italian: Riscatta il tuo bonus ogni giorno!
Translations.Portuguese: Resgate seu bônus todos os dias!

Translations.English: Your Loop Sort journey awaits! New puzzles and rewards ready for you! 🌟
Translations.Turkish: Loop Sort yolculuğun seni bekliyor! Yeni bulmacalar ve ödüller hazır! 🌟
Translations.French: Votre aventure Loop Sort vous attend ! De nouveaux puzzles et récompenses sont prêts pour vous ! 🌟
Translations.Japanese: Loop Sortの旅が待ってる！新しいパズルと報酬が準備完了！🌟
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 你的Loop Sort之旅在等你！全新谜题和奖励已为你准备好！🌟
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 你的Loop Sort之旅在等你！全新謎題和獎勵已為你準備好！🌟
Translations.Korean: Loop Sort 여정이 기다려요! 새로운 퍼즐과 보상이 준비됐어요! 🌟
Translations.Indonesian: Perjalanan Loop Sort-mu menanti! Teka-teki dan hadiah baru siap untukmu! 🌟
Translations.German: Deine Loop Sort-Reise wartet! Neue Rätsel und Belohnungen sind bereit für dich! 🌟
Translations.Spanish: ¡Tu aventura de Loop Sort te espera! ¡Nuevos puzles y recompensas listos para ti! 🌟
Translations.Italian: Il tuo viaggio in Loop Sort ti aspetta! Nuovi puzzle e ricompense sono pronti per te! 🌟
Translations.Portuguese: Sua jornada no Loop Sort está te esperando! Novos quebra-cabeças e recompensas prontos para você! 🌟
Translations.Russian: Твоё путешествие в Loop Sort ждёт! Новые головоломки и награды уже готовы для тебя! 🌟

Translations.English: 😭 We miss you! Here's 100 coins 🎁 to welcome you back warmly!
Translations.Turkish: 😭 Seni özledik! Geri dönüşünü kutlamak için 100 coin 🎁!
Translations.French: 😭 Vous nous manquez ! Voici 100 pièces 🎁 pour vous souhaiter un bon retour !
Translations.Japanese: 😭 会いたい！おかえりのプレゼントにコイン100枚🎁！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 😭 想你了！送你100金币🎁，欢迎回来！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 😭 想你了！送你100金幣🎁，歡迎回來！
Translations.Korean: 😭 보고 싶었어요! 따뜻하게 맞이하며 코인 100개 🎁 드려요!
Translations.Indonesian: 😭 Kami merindukanmu! Ini 100 koin 🎁 untuk menyambutmu kembali!
Translations.German: 😭 Wir vermissen dich! Hier sind 100 Münzen 🎁 als Willkommensgeschenk!
Translations.Spanish: 😭 ¡Te extrañamos! Aquí tienes 100 monedas 🎁 para darte la bienvenida.
Translations.Italian: 😭 Ci manchi! Ecco 100 monete 🎁 per darti un caloroso bentornato!
Translations.Portuguese: 😭 Sentimos sua falta! Aqui vão 100 moedas 🎁 para te dar as boas-vindas!
Translations.Russian: 😭 Мы скучаем! Вот 100 монет 🎁, чтобы тепло поприветствовать тебя!

Translations.Japanese: 🎁 超豪華おかえりギフト！

Translations.English: We have a surprise for you! Open the game and claim your gift! ! 🥳
Translations.Turkish: Senin için bir sürprizimiz var! Oyunu aç ve hediyeni al!! 🥳
Translations.French: Nous avons une surprise pour vous ! Ouvrez le jeu et récupérez votre cadeau ! ! 🥳
Translations.Japanese: サプライズがあるよ！ゲームを開いてギフトを受け取ろう！！🥳
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 我们为你准备了惊喜！打开游戏领取你的礼物！！🥳
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 我們為你準備了驚喜！打開遊戲領取你的禮物！！🥳
Translations.Korean: 깜짝 선물이 있어요! 게임을 열고 선물을 받아가세요!! 🥳
Translations.Indonesian: Kami punya kejutan untukmu! Buka game dan klaim hadiahmu!! 🥳
Translations.German: Wir haben eine Überraschung für dich! Öffne das Spiel und hol dir dein Geschenk!! 🥳
Translations.Spanish: ¡Tenemos una sorpresa para ti! Abre el juego y reclama tu regalo!! 🥳
Translations.Italian: Abbiamo una sorpresa per te! Apri il gioco e riscuoti il tuo regalo!! 🥳
Translations.Portuguese: Temos uma surpresa para você! Abra o jogo e resgate seu presente!! 🥳
Translations.Russian: У нас для тебя сюрприз! Открой игру и забери свой подарок!! 🥳

Translations.Japanese: 🎁 超豪華おかえりギフト！

Translations.English: Don’t miss it! A special gift is waiting for you in the game! 🥳
Translations.Turkish: Kaçırma! Oyunda seni özel bir hediye bekliyor! 🥳
Translations.French: Ne le manquez pas ! Un cadeau spécial vous attend dans le jeu ! 🥳
Translations.Japanese: 見逃さないで！ゲーム内で特別なギフトが待ってる！🥳
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 别错过！游戏里有特别礼物等你！🥳
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 別錯過！遊戲裡有特別禮物等你！🥳
Translations.Korean: 놓치지 마세요! 게임에서 특별한 선물이 기다려요! 🥳
Translations.Indonesian: Jangan lewatkan! Hadiah spesial menunggumu di dalam game! 🥳
Translations.German: Nicht verpassen! Ein besonderes Geschenk wartet im Spiel auf dich! 🥳
Translations.Spanish: ¡No te lo pierdas! ¡Un regalo especial te espera en el juego! 🥳
Translations.Italian: Non perdertelo! Un regalo speciale ti aspetta nel gioco! 🥳
Translations.Portuguese: Não perca! Um presente especial está te esperando no jogo! 🥳
Translations.Russian: Не пропусти! В игре тебя ждёт особый подарок! 🥳

Translations.English: Here's 1000 coins + boosters to cheer you up! 🥳
Translations.Turkish: Moralin yerine gelsin diye 1000 coin + güçlendirici! 🥳
Translations.French: Voici 1000 pièces + des boosters pour vous remonter le moral ! 🥳
Translations.Japanese: 元気出して！コイン1000枚＋ブースターだよ！🥳
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 送你1000金币+增益道具，打起精神！🥳
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 送你1000金幣+增益道具，打起精神！🥳
Translations.German: Hier sind 1000 Münzen + Booster, um dich aufzumuntern! 🥳
Translations.Italian: Ecco 1000 monete + booster per tirarti su! 🥳
Translations.Portuguese: Aqui vão 1000 moedas + boosters para te animar! 🥳
Translations.Russian: Вот 1000 монет + бустеры, чтобы поднять тебе настроение! 🥳

Translations.English: 😍 Your hearts are fully charged! Jump back in and crush that next level!
Translations.Turkish: 😍 Kalplerin tamamen doldu! Geri dön ve bir sonraki seviyeyi ez geç!
Translations.French: 😍 Vos cœurs sont rechargés à fond ! Revenez et écrasez le prochain niveau !
Translations.Japanese: 😍 ハートが満タン！戻って次のレベルをクリアしよう！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 😍 体力已充满！快回来挑战下一关吧！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 😍 體力已充滿！快回來挑戰下一關吧！
Translations.Korean: 😍 하트가 완전히 충전됐어요! 돌아와서 다음 레벨을 깨세요!
Translations.Indonesian: 😍 Hatimu sudah penuh! Masuk lagi dan taklukkan level berikutnya!
Translations.German: 😍 Deine Herzen sind voll aufgeladen! Spring wieder rein und schaff das nächste Level!
Translations.Spanish: 😍 ¡Tus corazones están al máximo! ¡Vuelve y supera el siguiente nivel!
Translations.Italian: 😍 I tuoi cuori sono al massimo! Torna e supera il prossimo livello!
Translations.Portuguese: 😍 Seus corações estão totalmente carregados! Volte e arrase no próximo nível!
Translations.Russian: 😍 Ваши сердца полностью заряжены! Возвращайтесь и пройдите следующий уровень!

Translations.English: Jump into the game and claim your rewards!
Translations.French: Plongez dans le jeu et récupérez vos récompenses !
Translations.Japanese: ゲームに入って報酬を受け取ろう！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 进入游戏领取你的奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 進入遊戲領取你的獎勵！
Translations.Indonesian: Masuk ke game dan klaim hadiahmu!
Translations.German: Spring ins Spiel und hol dir deine Belohnungen!
Translations.Spanish: ¡Entra al juego y reclama tus recompensas!
Translations.Italian: Entra nel gioco e riscuoti le tue ricompense!
Translations.Portuguese: Entre no jogo e resgate suas recompensas!
Translations.Russian: Заходите в игру и забирайте награды!

Translations.French: Votre compte n'a pas été débité !
Translations.Japanese: アカウントに請求されませんでした！
Translations.Spanish: ¡No se realizó ningún cargo en tu cuenta!
Translations.Italian: Il tuo account non è stato addebitato!
Translations.Portuguese: Nenhuma cobrança foi feita na sua conta!
Translations.Russian: С вашего аккаунта не списали средства!

Translations.Japanese: 購入が復元されました！
Translations.Italian: I tuoi acquisti sono stati ripristinati!

Translations.French: Échec de la restauration des achats !
Translations.Japanese: 購入の復元に失敗しました！

Translations.English: Beat levels without fail to get more rewards!
Translations.Turkish: Seviyeleri hata yapmadan geçerek daha fazla ödül kazan!
Translations.French: Réussis les niveaux sans échouer pour obtenir plus de récompenses!
Translations.Japanese: 失敗せずにレベルをクリアして、より多くの報酬を手に入れよう！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 不失误通关关卡以获得更多奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 不失誤通關關卡以獲得更多獎勵！
Translations.Korean: 실패 없이 레벨을 클리어하고 더 많은 보상을 받으세요!
Translations.Indonesian: Selesaikan level tanpa gagal untuk mendapatkan lebih banyak hadiah!
Translations.German: Schließe Level ohne Fehler ab, um mehr Belohnungen zu erhalten!
Translations.Spanish: Supera niveles sin fallar para obtener más recompensas!
Translations.Italian: Supera i livelli senza fallire per ottenere più ricompense!
Translations.Portuguese: Conclua fases sem falhar para ganhar mais recompensas!
Translations.Russian: Проходи уровни без ошибок, чтобы получить больше наград!

Translations.Japanese: レベルをクリアしよう!
豪華報酬を手に入れよう!
連絡用メールアドレス...
問題を説明してください...

Translations.English: Beat {0} levels to complete the challenge!
Translations.Turkish: Meydan okumayı tamamlamak için {0} seviye geç!
Translations.French: Terminez {0} niveaux pour relever le défi!
Translations.Japanese: {0}レベルをクリアしてチャレンジを完了しよう！
Translations.German: Schließe {0} Level ab, um die Herausforderung zu meistern!
Translations.Spanish: Supera {0} niveles para completar el desafío!
Translations.Italian: Supera {0} livelli per completare la sfida!
Translations.Portuguese: Conclua {0} níveis para completar o desafio!

Translations.English: Congratulations! You advanced to the next step!
Translations.French: Félicitations! Vous êtes passé à l'étape suivante!
Translations.Japanese: おめでとう！次のステップに進みました！
Translations.Indonesian: Selamat! Kamu melaju ke langkah berikutnya!
Translations.German: Glückwunsch! Du bist zum nächsten Schritt vorgerückt!
Translations.Italian: Congratulazioni! Sei passato al passo successivo!
Translations.Portuguese: Parabéns! Você avançou para a próxima etapa!
Translations.Russian: Поздравляем! Ты перешёл к следующему шагу!

Translations.French: Tu as échoué à la quête!
Translations.German: Du hast die Quest nicht geschafft!

Translations.French: Recherche de joueurs de ton niveau
Translations.Japanese: 同じレベルのプレイヤーを検索中
Translations.Italian: Ricerca di giocatori al tuo livello

Translations.Japanese: 失敗せずに\nレベルをクリアしよう！

Translations.Italian: Vinci la tua parte di <color=#E3A90E>{0}</color> monete

Translations.English:
Complete <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> levels to finish
 the quest.
Translations.Turkish: Görevi tamamlamak için <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> seviye tamamla\n görevi.
Translations.French: Termine <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> niveaux pour finir\n la quête.
Translations.Japanese: クエスト完了までに<color=#E58D45>{0}</color>レベルをクリア\n しよう。
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 完成<color=#E58D45>{0}</color>关以完成\n 任务。
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 完成<color=#E58D45>{0}</color>關以完成\n 任務。
Translations.German: Schließe <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> Level ab, um\n die Quest zu beenden.
Translations.Spanish: Completa <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> niveles para terminar\n la misión.
Translations.Italian: Completa <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> livelli per finire\n la missione.
Translations.Portuguese: Complete <color=#E58D45>{0}</color> níveis para concluir\n a missão.

Translations.English:
You failed the quest.
Next Treasure Hunt will start in:
Translations.Turkish: Görevde başarısız oldun.\nSonraki Hazine Avı şurada başlayacak:
Translations.French: Tu as échoué à la quête.\nLa prochaine Chasse au trésor commence dans:
Translations.Japanese: クエストに失敗しました。\n次のトレジャーハント開始まで:
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 任务失败。\n下一次寻宝将在以下时间开始:
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 任務失敗。\n下一次尋寶將於以下時間開始:
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu gagal dalam misi.\nPerburuan Harta berikutnya dimulai dalam:
Translations.German: Du hast die Quest nicht geschafft.\nDie nächste Schatzsuche startet in:
Translations.Spanish: Fallaste la misión.\nLa próxima Búsqueda del tesoro comenzará en:
Translations.Italian: Hai fallito la missione.\nLa prossima Caccia al tesoro inizierà tra:
Translations.Portuguese: Você falhou na missão.\nA próxima Caça ao Tesouro começará em:
Translations.Russian: Вы провалили задание.\nСледующая Охота за сокровищами начнется через:

Translations.English: You are sharing the reward with {0} other winners!
Translations.French: Tu partages la récompense avec {0} autres gagnants!
Translations.Japanese: あなたは{0}人の他の勝者と報酬を分け合っています！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 你将与另外{0}名获胜者分享奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 你將與另外{0}名得主分享獎勵！
Translations.Korean: 당신은 {0}명의 다른 승자와 보상을 나누고 있어요!
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu berbagi hadiah dengan {0} pemenang lainnya!
Translations.German: Du teilst die Belohnung mit {0} weiteren Gewinnern!
Translations.Spanish: ¡Estás compartiendo la recompensa con otros {0} ganadores!
Translations.Italian: Stai condividendo la ricompensa con altri {0} vincitori!
Translations.Portuguese: Você está compartilhando a recompensa com outros {0} vencedores!
Translations.Russian: Вы делите награду с {0} другими победителями!

Translations.Japanese: 100人のプレイヤーでスタート!

Translations.English: You will fail the Treasure Hunt!
Translations.French: Tu vas échouer à la chasse au trésor!
Translations.Japanese: トレジャーハントに失敗します！
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu akan gagal dalam Perburuan Harta Karun!
Translations.German: Du wirst bei der Schatzsuche scheitern!
Translations.Portuguese: Você vai falhar na Caça ao Tesouro!

Translations.Japanese: {0}はレベル{1}でアンロックされます

Translations.English: You will fail the Loop Tower!
Translations.French: Tu échoueras dans la Tour de la Boucle!
Translations.Japanese: ループタワーで失敗する！
Translations.Indonesian: Kamu akan gagal di Menara Loop!
Translations.Portuguese: Você vai falhar na Torre do Loop!

Translations.English: Each fail resets to checkpoint. Beat levels without failing to complete steps!
Translations.Turkish: Her başarısızlık kontrol noktasına sıfırlar. Adımları tamamlamak için hata yapmadan seviyeleri geç!
Translations.French: Chaque échec réinitialise au point de contrôle. Terminez les niveaux sans échouer pour compléter les étapes!
Translations.Japanese: 失敗するたびにチェックポイントに戻ります. 失敗せずにレベルをクリアしてステップを達成しよう!
Translations.ChineseSimplified: 每次失败都会回到检查点. 连续不失败通关关卡即可完成步骤!
Translations.ChineseTraditional: 每次失敗都會回到檢查點. 連續不失敗通關關卡即可完成步驟!
Translations.Korean: 실패할 때마다 체크포인트로 돌아갑니다. 실패하지 않고 레벨을 클리어해 단계를 완료하세요!
Translations.Indonesian: Setiap gagal akan kembali ke pos pemeriksaan. Selesaikan level tanpa gagal untuk menyelesaikan tahap!
Translations.German: Jeder Fehlschlag setzt dich zum Checkpoint zurück. Schließe Level ohne Fehlschlag ab, um Etappen zu absolvieren!
Translations.Spanish: Cada fallo te reinicia al punto de control. Supera niveles sin fallar para completar etapas!
Translations.Italian: Ogni fallimento ti riporta al checkpoint. Supera i livelli senza fallire per completare le fasi!
Translations.Portuguese: Cada falha volta ao checkpoint. Conclua níveis sem falhar para completar as etapas!
Translations.Russian: Каждый провал возвращает к контрольной точке. Проходи уровни без ошибок, чтобы пройти этапы!

Translations.English:
<color=#F5C531>Pick a Hat</color> to get
your daily reward!
Translations.French: <color=#F5C531>Choisis un chapeau</color> pour obtenir\nta récompense quotidienne!
Translations.Japanese: <color=#F5C531>帽子を選んで</color>\n毎日の報酬を受け取ろう！
Translations.ChineseSimplified: <color=#F5C531>选择一顶帽子</color>即可获得\n每日奖励！
Translations.ChineseTraditional: <color=#F5C531>選擇一頂帽子</color>即可獲得\n每日獎勵！
Translations.German: <color=#F5C531>Wähle einen Hut</color>, um\ndeine tägliche Belohnung zu erhalten!
Translations.Spanish: <color=#F5C531>Elige un sombrero</color> para conseguir\ntu recompensa diaria!
Translations.Italian: <color=#F5C531>Scegli un cappello</color> per ottenere\nla tua ricompensa giornaliera!
Translations.Portuguese: <color=#F5C531>Escolha um chapéu</color> para receber\nsua recompensa diária!
